== chd.py --help
usage: chd.py [-h]
              {create,verify,extract,info,delta,merge,compare,convert,import,batch-create,batch-verify,batch-import,import-tools}
              ...

CHD archive management: a wrapper for MAME's chdman.

Create, verify, extract, compare and re-compress CHD archives of disc images
and raw disk dumps, one file or a whole directory at a time.

Usage:
    python chd.py create <input> <output.chd> [options]
    python chd.py verify <file.chd>
    python chd.py extract <file.chd> <output>
    python chd.py info <file.chd> [--json]
    python chd.py delta <parent.chd> <child-input> <child.chd>
    python chd.py merge <parent.chd> <child.chd> <output.chd>
    python chd.py compare <file1.chd> <file2.chd>
    python chd.py convert <input.chd> <output.chd> [--compression <type>]
    python chd.py import <input> [<output.chd>]
    python chd.py batch-create <directory> [--format <ext>] [--delete-originals]
    python chd.py batch-verify <directory>
    python chd.py batch-import <directory> [--format <ext>] [--delete-originals]
    python chd.py import-tools

chdman reads .iso .img .bin .raw directly (createraw) and .cue .gdi .toc as
CDs (createcd). `import` also takes .cso .zso .dax .pbp .nrg .mdf .ecm and
.7z .zip .rar .gz archives, converting with the tools `import-tools` lists.

A cue, gdi or toc sheet and the track files it names are one disc: batches
convert the sheet, not its tracks on their own, and --delete-originals
deletes the tracks with it, never anything outside the sheet's directory.

Examples:
    python chd.py create game.iso game.chd
    python chd.py create disk.img disk.chd --compression lzma
    python chd.py create game.cue game.chd                     # CD with cue sheet
    python chd.py delta base.chd updated.img updated.chd       # child of base.chd
    python chd.py merge base.chd updated.chd standalone.chd    # child made whole
    python chd.py batch-create ~/roms/psx --format iso
    python chd.py batch-verify ~/roms/chd

Exit status: the failing chdman or converter status, 1 for a missing input
or any failed file in a batch, 2 when a required program is not installed.
`compare` exits 0 for identical, 1 for different, 2 for unreadable.

positional arguments:
  {create,verify,extract,info,delta,merge,compare,convert,import,batch-create,batch-verify,batch-import,import-tools}
                        Command to run
    create              Create CHD from disc image or raw dump
    verify              Verify CHD integrity
    extract             Extract CHD to a cue sheet (CDs) or raw image
    info                Show CHD metadata
    delta               Create delta (child) CHD from parent
    merge               Merge child CHD with its parent into a standalone CHD
    compare             Compare two CHD files
    convert             Re-compress CHD with different settings
    import              Convert any disc image format to CHD
    batch-create        Convert all matching files in a directory
    batch-verify        Verify all CHDs in a directory
    batch-import        Convert all disc images in a directory to CHD
    import-tools        Show which format conversion tools are installed

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
== chd.py create --help
usage: chd.py create [-h] [--compression {default,lzma,zlib,flac,none,best,fast}]
                     [--hunk-size HUNK_SIZE] [--force] [--dry-run]
                     input output

positional arguments:
  input                 Input file (.iso, .img, .bin, .raw, .cue, .gdi, .toc)
  output                Output CHD file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --compression {default,lzma,zlib,flac,none,best,fast}
                        Compression preset
  --hunk-size HUNK_SIZE
                        Hunk size in bytes, a multiple of 512 (default: auto)
  --force               Overwrite existing output
  --dry-run             Print what would run, and run nothing
== chd.py verify --help

positional arguments:
  file        CHD file to verify

  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
== chd.py extract --help
usage: chd.py extract [-h] [--force] [--dry-run] file output

positional arguments:
  file        CHD file to extract
  output      Output file (a .cue for a CD)

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --force     Overwrite existing output
  --dry-run   Print what would run, and run nothing

== chd.py delta --help
usage: chd.py delta [-h] [--dry-run] parent input output

positional arguments:
  parent      Parent CHD file
  input       Input file for child
  output      Output child CHD file

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --dry-run   Print what would run, and run nothing
== chd.py merge --help
usage: chd.py merge [-h] [--force] [--dry-run] parent child output

positional arguments:
  parent      Parent CHD file the child was made against
  child       Child CHD file
  output      Output standalone CHD file

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --force     Overwrite existing output
  --dry-run   Print what would run, and run nothing

== chd.py import --help
usage: chd.py import [-h] [--compression {default,lzma,zlib,flac,none,best,fast}] [--force]
                     [--keep-intermediate] [--dry-run]
                     input [output]

positional arguments:
  input                 Input file (ISO, CSO, PBP, NRG, MDF, ECM, CUE, GDI, 7z, zip, ...)
  output                Output CHD file (default: same name with .chd)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --compression {default,lzma,zlib,flac,none,best,fast}
  --force               Overwrite existing output
  --keep-intermediate   Keep converted and extracted files after conversion
  --dry-run             Print what would run, and run nothing
== chd.py batch-create --help
usage: chd.py batch-create [-h] [--format FORMAT] [--delete-originals] [--force] [--dry-run]
                           directory

positional arguments:
  directory           Directory to scan

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit
  --format FORMAT     File extensions to convert (comma-separated, e.g. iso,bin,cue)
  --delete-originals  Delete each original (and a sheet's tracks) once its CHD is made
  --force             Overwrite existing output
  --dry-run           Print what would run, and run nothing
== chd.py batch-verify --help

  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

== chd.py batch-import --help
usage: chd.py batch-import [-h] [--format FORMAT]
                           [--compression {default,lzma,zlib,flac,none,best,fast}]
                           [--delete-originals] [--keep-intermediate] [--force] [--dry-run]
                           directory

positional arguments:
  directory             Directory to scan

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format FORMAT       File extensions to convert (comma-separated)
  --compression {default,lzma,zlib,flac,none,best,fast}
  --delete-originals    Delete each original (and a sheet's tracks) once its CHD is made
  --keep-intermediate   Keep converted and extracted files after conversion
  --force               Overwrite existing output
  --dry-run             Print what would run, and run nothing
